instalation of all the required package

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("tidyverse"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("lme4"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("Hmisc"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("corrplot"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("emmeans"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("performance"))

```

preparation of the data based on the result from the filtering script :

```{r}
data250fabae <- read.csv("../../01.repetability_choice_Nrep/01_A.fabae/final filters/aphis_fabae_data_filtered.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = ",") %>%  mutate(genotype = as.factor(genotype)) %>% mutate(session = as.factor(session)) 
```

```{r}
data250fabae %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = larvae_total_number)) + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "white", color = "black") 
```

```{r}
model <- lmer(larvae_total_number ~ ivip + (1 | session/block), data = data250fabae)

```

```{r}

anova(model)

#variance stability





# Extract fitted values and residuals
fitted_values <- fitted(model)
residuals_values <- residuals(model)

#homosedasticity
# Plot residuals vs fitted values
plot(fitted_values, residuals_values, 
     main="Residuals vs Fitted", 
     xlab="Fitted values", 
     ylab="Residuals")
abline(h=0, col="red")

#residual normality
hist(residuals_values, main="Histogram of Residuals", xlab="Residuals", breaks=20)
# 2. Q-Q Plot for Residuals
qqnorm(residuals_values)
qqline(residuals_values, col = "red")

shapiro_result <- shapiro.test(residuals_values)
    
    # Print the p-value (this is your quantification of normality)
    shapiro <- shapiro_result$p.value

#residual independance
# Plot residuals over time (for time-series data)
plot(residuals(model), type="o", col="blue", main="Residuals over Time", xlab="Index", ylab="Residuals")


# Extract EMMeans for genotype
emm_genotype <- emmeans(model, ~ ivip)
emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm_genotype)
hist(emm_df$emmean)

emm_df <- emm_df[,c(1,2)]

# Define the file path
file_path <- "~/Documents/gitrepo/faba_specifics/02.analyses/01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/02.ajusted_means/emmeans_fabae.csv"

# Save the data frame to the specified location
  write.csv(emm_df, file = file_path, row.names = FALSE)


```
